description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Analytics' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. Custom events - Firebase Analytics parity. The game sends its own events (logEvent(name, params, value)); the engine stores them per player per UTC day and the dashboard reports counts, unique players, value sums and breakdowns by platform, app version, OS, device, language, country, new/returning and acquisition source; A/B experiment goals and custom funnel steps can use these events. Enabled is the master switch and defaults to OFF. EventNaming: "Open" (any valid name is accepted and joins the title's event catalog up to the PLAN limit) or "Declared" (only names listed in Events). Events maps an event name (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$; prefixes idos_/firebase_/google_/ga_ are reserved, except the automatic idos_* events) to a display name, description and a Blocked flag. Dimensions registers event parameters as reporting dimensions (like GA4 custom dimensions) - the count is capped by the plan; unregistered parameters are accepted but not stored. RetentionDays is how long per-player event data is kept (default 90, capped by the plan); daily title summaries are kept forever. AutomaticEvents (default on) accepts the SDK's automatic events: idos_first_open, idos_session_start, idos_app_update, idos_os_update, idos_screen_view.

AnalyticsDimensionDefinition.description: An event parameter registered as a reporting dimension.

ParamName.description: Parameter name as the game sends it (^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,39}$).

Blocked.description: Blocked: events with this name are dropped in any naming mode.

Description.description: What the event means and when the game sends it.

Highlight.description: Highlight weight 1-10 for auto-clips: when the game logs this event, the player's background recording marks the moment, and the heaviest marks become their Best moments clips. Unset = not a highlight. Works even with analytics off (marking happens in the browser).

value.description: Custom events (Firebase Analytics parity). Everything here is chosen by the publisher within their plan's analytics limits. Absent section or Enabled != true = events are not stored and cost no database access.

AutomaticEvents.description: Automatic SDK events (idos_first_open, idos_session_start, idos_app_update, idos_os_update, idos_screen_view). Unset = on: DAU and sessions by version/platform/device are computed from them.

Dimensions.description: Event parameters registered as dimensions (like GA4 custom dimensions): reports can break events down by them. Unregistered parameters are accepted but not stored. Count is capped by the plan.

Enabled.description: Master switch. Unset = off: events are dropped without touching the database, and the SDK does not send them.

EventNaming.description: Event naming mode: "Open" (default — any valid name is accepted and joins the title's event catalog up to the plan limit) or "Declared" (only names listed in Events are accepted).

Events.description: Described events keyed by event name. In Declared mode the only accepted names; in Open mode — display names and blocks.

RetentionDays.description: Retention of per-player event data, days. Unset = 90 (or the plan maximum if lower). Clamped to the plan maximum. Daily title summaries are kept forever.
